faq.q: What are Domed Hills in GTA 6?
faq.a: Domed Hills is a mountain range listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki. The wiki entry is the only record of them. Rockstar has not named them in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

faq.q: Are Domed Hills confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Domed Hills as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names them.

faq.q: What does the wiki say about Domed Hills?
faq.a: The wiki gives 3 details. Place type: mountain range. Scope: area. Coordinates: not given. Those are wiki fields copied as they stand. No figure here was measured in the game, because the game has not released.

faq.q: Where does this Domed Hills information come from?
faq.a: From the GTA Fandom wiki page for Domed Hills, collected by the outlawdb project on 2026-09-13 and released under CC BY-SA 3.0. The source link on this page opens the wiki page itself, so you can read the same entry.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Domed Hills?
faq.a: Most of it. Domed Hills rest on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. The boundary of the area and what is inside it are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Domed Hills be in the finished GTA 6?
faq.a: Not known. A wiki listing is a claim by a fan editor, not a Rockstar statement. Plenty of location entries written before a launch never appear in the game. This site records the claim and the source, and marks the entry unconfirmed until that changes.
